notes: GPU note: wire_changed and wire_nchanged are file-static mutable state in blockcb.c. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was switched_off/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). lane/idxredstone 2026-09-27: exact. The player could not place redstone dust natively: survival.c sent ItemRedstone to itemuse.c, which has no case for it (rs-wire-s1 failed at row 24); it now goes through place.c item_redstone_on_item_use on the server and in the client's prediction. rs-wire-s1 places seven dusts, breaks one by hand, pulls its floor, and places and breaks dust beside a water pit.
